target_claim_note: The whole-theory target is the checked released GU grammar on the selected K77 real form with its source-owned fields, coefficients, variations and reductions frozen. It is not the W203/W229 K95 record-current reconstruction and it is not an open-ended class containing arbitrary future completions.

falsification_domains.quantifier_domain: The frozen W203/W229 record-current exact-vacuum construction and its predeclared bounded escape census.
falsification_domains.reason: The principled Schwarzschild quadratic trace-free residual is nonzero while Psi=0 gives J=0, theta=0 and no source/YM cancellation tensor; kappa and Z_U cannot tune zero into minus QTF. W154/W229 is a conditional K95 composite and is nonadmitted as the selected K77 action owner.

falsification_domains.quantifier_domain: SC-ACT-01 through SC-ACT-06 on the selected K77 real form, after all source-owned fields, coefficients, variations, constraints, boundary conditions and the native Y=MET(X) to observed-X reduction are frozen target-blind.
falsification_domains.reason: No present artifact jointly owns even SF-1 and SF-4, so the universal domain and native stationary solution space do not yet exist as an evaluable object.

falsification_domains.quantifier_domain: Any future action, field, constraint, adapter or boundary completion someone might later call GU.
falsification_domains.reason: An unbounded completion class has no frozen universal quantifier. A new unowned term proposed after a D1 kill is a new construction, not an escape inside the tested released theory.

current_residual_receipt.imported_metric: Schwarzschild and Kerr controls, not native solutions
current_residual_receipt.linear_order: All five built projected-section terms vanish on the imported Psi=0 Schwarzschild/Kerr slices at linear order in M, with Kerr rotation carried through the harmonic multipole argument.
current_residual_receipt.quadratic_order: A nonzero trace-free Q(B) residual survives in the principled native second-fundamental-form branch. Existing records use different radial-order conventions; nonzero and quadratic in M are the contract facts.
current_residual_receipt.record_current_source: Psi=0 implies J=0 and theta=0 in the W229 record-current branch, hence no cancellation tensor.
current_residual_receipt.result: D0-W229-RECORD-CURRENT is BOUNDED_NO_GO; no D1 verdict follows.

strongfield_requirements.requirement: Derive the complete selected-K77 vacuum equation, projected section residual, coefficients including alpha_W, and E_s^theta from the released action grammar with all Euler and Hilbert roles frozen target-blind.
strongfield_requirements.evidence: W154/W229 is nonadmitted as K77 owner; SC-ACT-02 is an annotated recovery sketch rather than the observed equation; no coefficient-complete native strong-field action packet exists.

strongfield_requirements.requirement: Derive the observed matter coupling and the worldline or ray equation used for timelike and null motion.
strongfield_requirements.evidence: The imported geodesic structure has comparator value only; no source-owned observed coupling packet is registered for LT-GR9.

strongfield_requirements.requirement: Construct the K77/Y=MET(X) to observed Lorentzian X reduction, gauge/constraint quotient, causal region, boundary data and hyperbolic evolution problem.
strongfield_requirements.evidence: The current action qualification records missing intrinsic MET(X) Hilbert roles, observation variables and complete domains; Euclidean moduli language in SC-ACT-06 is not this Lorentzian reduction.

strongfield_requirements.requirement: Solve the native reduced equations for at least one stationary horizon-bearing asymptotically admissible background without importing Schwarzschild or Kerr.
strongfield_requirements.evidence: W225/W238 import the target metrics; the local tautological K77 residual-zero candidate lacks native Y legality, global section, free-edge legality and strong-field interpretation.

strongfield_requirements.requirement: Derive the branch-specific perturbation operator, physical boundary conditions, characteristic or quasinormal spectrum, and the shadow/ringdown comparator map.
strongfield_requirements.evidence: No branch-specific strong-field K_total/L_total, closed domain, physical quotient, ray map or ringdown spectrum is constructed.

admission: D1 quantifier domain is frozen and source/action complete.
SF-1, SF-2 and SF-3 are constructed before inspecting a target metric or target-shaped residual.
The stationary ansatz, boundary class, gauge/constraint quotient and numerical tolerances are preregistered.
Any allowed coefficient or datum is fixed independently of the strong-field target.

theory_wide_kill_horns.condition: The admitted D1 equations have no stationary horizon-bearing solution in the frozen physical domain.
Every admitted stationary candidate has a nonzero, non-gauge, non-constraint projected residual or fails the native boundary/domain conditions.

Native stationary solutions exist, but every solution in the frozen class violates the preregistered motion, shadow or leading ringdown comparator after nuisance freedom and uncertainty are accounted for.

decision_logic.clear_condition: At least one target-blind native stationary horizon-bearing solution survives the physical quotient and boundary conditions, and its derived matter/ray coupling plus leading shadow and ringdown outputs pass the frozen comparator. This clears the strong-field leg at the stated grade; it does not prove uniqueness or all of GU.
invalid_shortcuts: Import Schwarzschild or Kerr as the GU stationary background.
Define a source or ambient term as minus the observed residual.
Transfer W154/W229 K95 ownership through dimension, notation or complexification alone.
Promote a branch-local bounded no-go into D1 without action-domain completeness.
Treat an unbounded future-completion class as the theory-wide quantifier domain.
Call a zero linear residual an exact strong-field clearance while the quadratic residual or observables remain open.

next_frontier.objective: Freeze the SC-ACT-01 through SC-ACT-06 selected-K77 field/action/variation domain and derive the observed vacuum equation through SF-1 and SF-3, before choosing a black-hole metric.
next_frontier.success: A coefficient-complete target-blind observed strong-field operator and physical domain.
next_frontier.failure: A proved source/action inconsistency or no legal observed reduction closes D1 before metric comparison.

next_frontier.objective: Solve the admitted equations on a preregistered stationary spherical class first, then the axisymmetric class only if the spherical gate survives.
next_frontier.success: A native horizon-bearing family with boundary and gauge certificates.
next_frontier.failure: K1 or K2 fires for the complete frozen class.

next_frontier.objective: Derive ray/matter motion and the branch perturbation operator, then confront shadow scale and leading ringdown ratios without retuning.
next_frontier.success: The LT-GR9 comparator is cleared at its frozen scope.
